name: Minimise clusterrolebindings
description: Fail non-system ClusterRoleBindings that grant cluster-wide roles to service accounts.
long_description: ISM-1883 (partial): RBAC and service-account findings show Kubernetes privilege breadth; they do not prove authorisation workflow, human account lifecycle or external systems.
remediation: Replace service-account ClusterRoleBindings with namespace-scoped RoleBindings where possible, or document why cluster-wide access is required.

provenance.rationale: Upstream administrative-role controls identify cluster-admin-equivalent access, not every non-system cluster-wide service-account binding.
